title: 第15章 燕文冕是个良民第16章 贤弟
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
“燕兄~”唐金春出现在燕文冕面前。
燕文冕的修为比唐金春高出一大截，说实在话，打心里是有点不屑于和唐金春说话的，也不大乐意和他有什么交情：“我弟子呢？”
“小葛犯了非常严重的宗门律令，现在已经被带去行刑司了。”
“唐金春！”燕文冕眼睛一瞪，眼中的威胁非常的明显。
审讯司老头子虽然修为不高，人也怯懦加怂，但好心好意，却被眼神威胁，纵然是他这种老实人，也忍不住有脾气了。
“喂，燕文冕，若不是我保着你弟子，他现在必死无疑，你觉得这是和我说话的态度吗？”
燕文冕这才收敛一些：“那我弟子怎么样了呢？”
“哼！”确保了燕文冕没有在执法堂大闹，唐金春摆了一个脸色：“死罪可免，活罪难逃，现在押完行刑司处刑，外加罚款一万灵石，这件事情就这么过去了。”
“一万灵石？”燕文冕先是错愕了一下，然后就是一阵怒意：“你们执法堂好大的胃口。”
“宗门律令第22条写得非常明白。”
“你跟我谈宗门律令？”燕文冕眉头一皱，在他的世界里，谁的拳头大，谁就是真理，律法都是束缚普通人的。
“这也不关我事情啊，曹长老是个认死理的，若是不按照宗门律令行事，我可不能担保你的弟子能不能活~”
燕文冕又怒了：“你在威胁我？”
这时，行刑司长老欧阳林一个闪身，也来到了执法堂门口。“燕山主，这已经是最好的结果。”
燕文冕看着欧阳林，哼了一声，只要弟子无事就好。“那姓曹的在哪里，让他来见我。”
燕文冕大步的朝执法堂内走去。
两长老跟在后面。
燕文冕根本就看不起曹立，这种小屁孩，岁数都没他一个零头大呢，修为更是一个小小的筑基。
“姓曹的呢？”燕文冕对着执法堂内的办公人员喊道。
“见过燕山主，曹长老在楼上。”有人回答。

燕文冕径直的朝执法长老的办公室走去。
曹立坐在里面，他能感受到一股强横的气息朝自己这边而来，越来越近。
曹立挥手，办公室的门无人自开。
这时，燕文冕正好走到执法司长老办公室门口。
“哼！”燕文冕大步走了进来。
他看到了坐在椅子上面的曹立。“你就是姓曹的？”
燕文冕板着个脸，跟有人欠他钱一样，说话语气也是冒火的，丝毫不客气。
“本人正是曹立。”曹立也没有恭迎，就坐在自己的办公室里面。
“曹立~我弟子你抓的？”
曹立看了看这位鹤发童颜的老头子，岁数看不出来，但一定很大，那白净的脸蛋，已经被气血涨红了，是个比较冲动的人。
曹立没有立刻回答他的话，而是淡淡的道：“本长老也是不想的，但葛颜实在是太狂了，只能按照规矩办事了。”
“你可知道他是谁的弟子？”
“遵守宗规是每个凌阳宗人都应尽的职责。”
content_en:
"Brother Yan~" Tang Jinchun appeared in front of Yan Wenmian.
Yan Wenmian's cultivation level is much higher than that of Tang Jinchun. To be honest, he is a little disdainful to talk to Tang Jinchun, and he is not willing to have any friendship with him: "Where is my disciple?"
"Xiao Ge has violated a very serious sect law and has now been taken to the Execution Department."
"Tang Jinchun!" Yan Wenmian glared, the threat in his eyes was very obvious.
Although the old man from the interrogation department was not very knowledgeable and timid, he had good intentions, but was threatened by his eyes. Even an honest man like him couldn't help but lose his temper.
"Hey, Yan Wenmian, if I hadn't protected your disciple, he would definitely be dead now. Do you think this is your attitude when talking to me?"
Yan Wenmian then calmed down a little: "Then how is my disciple?"
"Hmph!" Tang Jinchun made sure that Yan Wenmian did not make a fuss in the law enforcement hall, and said with a face: "The death penalty can be avoided, but the living crime cannot be escaped. Now that the execution department has sent him to the execution department for execution, plus a fine of 10,000 spiritual stones, this matter is over."
"Ten thousand spiritual stones?" Yan Wenmian was stunned for a moment, and then said with anger: "Your law enforcement hall has such a big appetite."
"Article 22 of the sect's law is very clear."
"Are you talking to me about the sect's laws?" Yan Wenmian frowned. In his world, whoever has the biggest fist is the truth, and laws bind ordinary people.
"This is none of my business. Elder Cao is a die-hard man. If you don't act in accordance with the sect's laws, I can't guarantee whether your disciple will survive~"
Yan Wenmian was angry again: "Are you threatening me?"
At this time, Ouyang Lin, the elder of the execution department, stepped out of the way and arrived at the door of the law enforcement hall. "Master Yanshan, this is the best result."
Yan Wenmian looked at Ouyang Lin and snorted, as long as nothing happens to his disciple. "Where is the man named Cao? Let him come to see me."
Yan Wenmian strode towards the law enforcement hall.
The two elders followed behind.
Yan Wenmian looked down upon Cao Li at all. This little brat was not even a fraction of his age, and his cultivation level was only a small foundation.
"Where is the person named Cao?" Yan Wenmian shouted to the office staff in the law enforcement hall.
"I've met Lord Yanshan, Elder Cao is upstairs." someone answered.
Yan Wenmian walked straight towards the law enforcement elder's office.
Cao Li sat inside, and he could feel a strong aura coming towards him, getting closer and closer.
Cao Li waved his hand, and no one opened the door to the office.
At this time, Yan Wenmian happened to walk to the door of the office of the elder of the Law Enforcement Department.
"Hmph!" Yan Wenmian strode in.
He saw Cao Li sitting on the chair. "Is your surname Cao?"
Yan Wenmian had a straight face, as if someone owed him money, and his tone of voice was angry and not polite at all.
"I am Cao Li." Cao Li did not greet him respectfully and just sat in his office.
"Cao Li~ Did you capture my disciple?"
Cao Li looked at the old man with gray hair and boyish face. He couldn't tell his age, but he must be very old. His fair face was already red with blood, and he was a rather impulsive person.
Cao Li did not answer him immediately, but said calmly: "I don't want to do it either, but Ge Yan is too crazy, so we can only act according to the rules."
"Do you know whose disciple he is?"
"It is the duty of every Lingyang Sect member to abide by the sect's rules."
